objective_basis.basis: This proposal uses a shared target within each call level, with fixed duties included. Dated eligibility limits assignments, but this objective does not minimize personal pro-rata deviation. Safety and required coverage remain higher priorities. Worst call-level gap precedes squared count deviation; hours and extra-duty burden also count. Preferences and repair stability follow fairness.
